name: Delivery Tracker style
notes: Warm near-black background, muted teal accent, amber and brick-red for status.
Numbers always use the mono face with tabular figures so columns line up.
Inputs are 16px so iOS Safari doesn't zoom on focus.
Mobile first: 720px max content width, fixed bottom tab bar, safe-area insets.

bg.use: page background, PWA theme/background color, input fields

card.use: card and tab bar surface, default button fill

muted.use: labels, secondary text, inactive tabs, table heads

accent.use: primary buttons, active tab, focus ring, links, eyebrow text, progress fill when on track

accent-ink.use: headings, big numbers, the app title, toast background

bad.use: negative status text, danger buttons, behind-pace progress fill, error toast

bad-bg.use: negative chip background, danger button border

thrive.meaning: at or above the stretch target

display.use: h1, h2, h3, eyebrow labels, tab bar, period navigator label

mono.use: every number: money, stats, big figures, chips, number/date/time inputs

layout.topbar: sticky, bg background, 3px accent bottom border, padding calc(12px + safe-area-top) 16px 10px
layout.tabbar: fixed bottom, card background, 1px line top border, equal-width buttons, active = accent text + 3px inset top bar
layout.bodyBottomPadding: calc(66px + safe-area-bottom) to clear the tab bar

components.card: background card, 1px solid line, radius 10px, padding 14px, margin-bottom 12px
components.cardLive: card with 5px solid accent left border (line color when idle)
components.button: inherit font, radius 8px, 1px solid line, background card, text color, padding 12px 14px
components.buttonPrimary: background + border accent, text on-accent, weight 700
components.input: 16px, background field, 1px solid line, radius 8px, padding 10px, full width; focus = 2px solid accent outline, offset -1px
components.label: column flex, gap 4px, 13px muted, margin-bottom 10px
components.chip: inline-block pill, padding 3px 9px, 12px weight 600 mono, colors from status map
components.progressBar: 10px tall, radius 5px, track color; fill = bad when behind, accent when on track; optional 2px text-colored tick marking expected-by-today
components.dataRows: CSS grid rows, 14px, 9px vertical padding, 1px line separators; header row 11px uppercase muted; today's row bold accent-ink; numbers right-aligned
components.infoPanel: 13px, padding 8px 10px, radius 8px, accent-soft background with accent-ink text (warn variant uses warn-bg/warn)
components.toast: fixed bottom-center above tab bar, accent-ink background, bg-colored text, 14px weight 600, radius 8px, fades via opacity .2s; error variant bad background
components.selectedRow: accent-soft background, radius 6px, bleeds 8px past the row edges
